title: Constellation Acquisition Corp I 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Constellation Acquisition Corp I (CSTAF), a Cayman Islands-incorporated SPAC, filed a Form 8-K on April 15, 2026, announcing a rescheduling of an investor webinar for its proposed business combination with HiTech Minerals Inc. and US Elemental Inc. (target entity to be listed as PubCo on Nasdaq). The webinar was moved to April 22, 2026 at 10AM Eastern Time. The filing contains standard forward-looking statement disclaimers and Regulation FD disclosure language.
key_points: Registrant: Constellation Acquisition Corp I, incorporated in Cayman Islands, ticker CSTAF on OTCQB market
Business combination involves CSTA, HiTech Minerals Inc., and US Elemental Inc. (to become PubCo)
Investor webinar rescheduled from original date to April 22, 2026 at 10AM Eastern Time
Exchange listings on OTCQB include Class A ordinary shares (CSTAF), warrants (CSTWF), and units (CSTUF)
Registrant qualifies as an emerging growth company under Rule 405 of the Securities Act
Exhibit 99.1 contains the joint press release; Exhibits 99.2 and 99.3 contain investor relations notices
